title: Luxuriantly Gooey Canadian Cheese Poutine
description: A garlicky, gooey, show-off Canadian dish featuring bouquet garni and mantecare-emulsify techniques, served in a Korean brass bowl.

ingredients.name: Russet potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into 1/2 inch fries

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the potato fries with olive oil and season with salt, then spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are roasting, melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the gravy mix to the saucepan and whisk to combine, then bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the bouquet garni and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and increase the oven temperature to broil.
Transfer the potatoes to a Korean brass bowl and top with cheese curds and spoon the gravy over the top.
Place the bowl under the broiler and cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the bowl from the oven and let cool for 2 minutes before serving.
